job.title: [Post] We're #Hiring – React.js + Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) Technical Lead Experience: 4–8…

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Senior Java Developer | Techno-Functional Consultant
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, RESTful and OCC APIs, and in designing PIM/ERP/MDM integrations. Proven record of building CI/CD pipelines, Docker/Kubernetes deployments, and providing production support. Skilled techno-functional consultant: gathering requirements, writing user stories, and bridging business and IT. Strong agile team player with AI-assisted development experience.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: React.js + Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) Technical Lead
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Avtech’s ambition to build cutting-edge e-commerce experiences on Salesforce Commerce Cloud. With over five years designing, extending and supporting SAP Commerce Cloud platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in API-driven, headless commerce architectures that can accelerate your SFCC initiatives.

bullets.label: **API Integration**
bullets.text: Led end-to-end PIM-to-Commerce data pipelines and ERP integrations, optimizing OCC REST services to ensure reliable product and catalog synchronization across global channels.

bullets.label: **Techno-Functional Consulting**
bullets.text: Collaborated with business stakeholders to translate requirements into functional specifications and user stories, driving seamless delivery in agile teams.

bullets.label: **CI/CD & Cloud Deployments**
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) using Docker and Kubernetes, shortening release times and enhancing system stability.

bullets.label: **Leadership & Mentoring**
bullets.text: Provided technical guidance and code reviews for junior developers, fostering best-practice adoption and high-quality codebases.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, I hold a valid German work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to Avtech.

tailoring.why_company: Avtech’s focus on delivering modern, cloud-native e-commerce solutions aligns perfectly with my passion for building scalable, API-first platforms. I admire the company’s commitment to leveraging cutting-edge technologies such as React and Salesforce Commerce Cloud to create seamless shopping experiences. Joining Avtech would allow me to apply my SAP Commerce expertise to accelerate your digital commerce roadmap while growing within a forward-thinking team.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to help Avtech accelerate its SFCC projects by applying my proven SAP Commerce integration and API expertise, delivering robust, scalable commerce solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years delivering API-driven e-commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m keen to bring my integration and techno-functional expertise to Avtech’s SFCC initiatives.
tailoring.offer: In the first months I will streamline your API integration layer by applying my OCC and PIM-ERP experience, and accelerate SFCC front-end enablement through proven headless commerce patterns. My background in CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes deployments and production support will ensure reliable, fast releases.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for React.js + Salesforce Commerce Cloud Technical Lead
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, I am Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with over five years of experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I am attracted to Avtech’s innovative work on React and Salesforce Commerce Cloud and believe my strong background in API-driven, headless commerce, PIM/ERP integrations and CI/CD pipelines can add immediate value. I can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. Please find my CV and cover letter attached. Best regards,
